name: Apollo 11
description: First crewed landing on the Moon, in the Sea of Tranquility.

name: Apollo 12
description: Second crewed landing, a precise touchdown close to the Surveyor 3 probe in the Ocean of Storms.

name: Apollo 14
description: Third crewed landing, in the Fra Mauro highlands.

name: Apollo 15
description: First mission with a lunar rover, landing at Hadley Rille near the Apennine mountains.

name: Apollo 16
description: First landing in the lunar highlands, in the Descartes region.

name: Apollo 17
description: The last crewed landing on the Moon, in the Taurus-Littrow valley.

name: Surveyor 3
description: US robotic lander in Oceanus Procellarum. Apollo 12 astronauts walked to it and brought back parts of the probe.

name: Luna 9
description: First spacecraft to make a controlled soft landing on the Moon and send pictures from the surface. Its exact position is still uncertain.

name: Luna 16
description: Soviet robotic probe that returned about 100 grams of lunar soil to Earth from the Sea of Fertility.

name: Luna 17
description: Delivered Lunokhod 1, the first remote-controlled rover on another world, to the Sea of Rains.

name: Luna 21
description: Delivered the Lunokhod 2 rover to Le Monnier crater, at the edge of the Sea of Serenity.

name: Luna 24
description: Last Soviet lunar mission; it brought back about 170 grams of soil from the Sea of Crises.

name: Chang'e 3
description: China's first lunar lander, which carried the Yutu rover to the Sea of Rains.

name: Chang'e 4
description: First soft landing on the far side of the Moon, inside Von Karman crater, with the Yutu-2 rover.

name: Chang'e 5
description: Sample-return mission that collected about 1.7 kg of lunar material in the Oceanus Procellarum region.

name: Chandrayaan-3
description: Indian lander that touched down near the south pole, making India the fourth country to land on the Moon.

name: SLIM
description: Japanese pinpoint-landing demonstrator that touched down very close to its target near Shioli crater, though it ended up tipped over.

name: IM-1 Odysseus
description: First US commercial lander on the Moon. It landed near the south pole and came to rest on its side.

name: Chang'e 6
description: First sample return from the far side of the Moon, collected in the South Pole-Aitken basin.

name: Blue Ghost 1
description: Firefly's commercial lander, which worked on the surface in Mare Crisium.

name: Beresheet
description: Israeli lander that crashed during its landing attempt.

name: Vikram (Chandrayaan-2)
description: Indian lander that lost contact during descent near the south pole and crashed.

name: Hakuto-R Mission 1
description: Lander from the Japanese company ispace that crashed after misjudging its altitude.

name: Luna 25
description: Russian lander lost when an orbit-lowering manoeuvre went wrong and it crashed.

name: Hakuto-R Mission 2
description: Second lander from ispace, which crashed during its landing attempt.
